finalText:
**Fixed.** 3 of 625 cases were failing, all in `orderTotal`.

`orderTotal` was taxing the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted one, contradicting its own comment ("tax the amount the customer pays"). Fixed in [src/pricing.js:41](src/pricing.js:41) to tax `discounted` instead of `cents`.

Suite now reports `625 total, 625 passing, 0 failing`.

Next: nothing, suite is green.
